mentions.name: Dev Cleaner
mentions.description: An offline, cross-platform desktop application that scans for development cache files and build artifacts such as node_modules, .cargo/registry, and .npm, and safely removes them to help developers reclaim disk space. It is closed source with a planned paid license.
mentions.problem: Development caches and build artifacts (like node_modules, .cargo/registry, and .npm) accumulate and consume disk space.
mentions.audience: Developers who need to reclaim disk space used by development caches.
mentions.source_excerpt: Dev Cleaner is a desktop application for scanning and cleaning development cache files and build artifacts. It helps developers reclaim disk space by identifying and safely removing caches like node_modules, .cargo/registry, .npm, and other build artifacts.

evidence.value: Dev Cleaner is a desktop application for scanning and cleaning development cache files and build artifacts. It helps developers reclaim disk space by identifying and safely removing caches like node_modules, .cargo/registry, .npm, and other build artifacts.
